overview: A selection of memories, dreams, conversations from different places and of different people captured on Tri-X Super 8 film. Everything seems mixed and jumbled up, yet is unified through a dynamic soundscape. This is a film-diary that jumps through time and space, and finds connections between various sceneries and situations, which ordinarily would not find each other together. Made over the course of two years of accumulating footage and sound.
